maddeler.e:
نستنكح (form X)
# نَسْتَنْكِحُ (nastankiḥu) /nas.tan.ki.ħu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَنْكَحَ (istankaḥa)
# نَسْتَنْكِحَ (nastankiḥa) /nas.tan.ki.ħa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَنْكَحَ (istankaḥa)
# نَسْتَنْكِحْ (nastankiḥ) /nas.tan.kiħ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَنْكَحَ (istankaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
